io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

Class ItemMetaCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility.ItemMetaCompat

  • public final class ItemMetaCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port: reflective access to ItemMeta methods that do not exist at the 1.8.8 compile floor.

    setUnbreakable/isUnbreakable are 1.11+ (on 1.8 the flag lived on the Spigot sub-API) and the custom-model-data accessors are 1.14+. All are reached reflectively so the code compiles against 1.8.8 while keeping full behaviour on modern servers; reads degrade to sensible defaults on legacy.
